channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NSF launches two Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation invests $50 million in research infrastructure to accelerate materials discovery and development.

item.title: Ancient Arctic carbon flows into sea, seabed traps most
item.description: Thawing permafrost releases ancient carbon into the ocean, but most is captured by seabed sediments, reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

item.title: Moonquakes may help detect hidden water beneath the lunar surface
item.description: The way moonquakes bend and reflect vibrations could reveal hidden ice, helping astronauts locate vital water resources.

item.title: Simple supplement may boost immune defense against cancer and viruses
item.description: Low arginine levels can reduce a key warning protein, letting cancer and viruses evade the immune system. Supplementing may help.
